title: Tailscale
description: See which of your Tailscale devices are online and copy a device's Tailscale IP or name without opening the Tailscale menu, from Hyper+Space, its own page or the menu bar.
examples: Type pi: your Raspberry Pi with its OS, IP and whether it is online; Return copies its 100.x IP
Glance at the menu bar: 🛜 3 says three devices are online; click it for the list, online first, each with its IP, and when an offline one was last seen
